slides.heading: Minimum Characters For Words
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Medium · Strings
slides.narration: Let's solve Minimum Characters For Words, a medium strings problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Smallest multiset of characters that can spell each word (one at a time).
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Smallest multiset of characters that can spell each word (one at a time).

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: For each character, we need the maximum count it reaches in any single word.
slides.narration: For each character, we need the maximum count it reaches in any single word.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Per-char max frequency across words → O(total chars)
slides.narration: Counting all characters together overcounts. What matters is, for each character, the maximum number of times any single word uses it.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 3. Emit each character that many times
slides.narration: Step by step. First, count characters per word. Second, keep the max per character. Third, emit each character that many times.
